## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintenance change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check:runtime` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests cover changed contracts, domain rules, trust boundaries, persistence behavior, or deployment artifacts.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] Fixtures and examples contain only synthetic data.
- [ ] No credentials, posting content, source URLs, workflow payloads, filesystem contents, or personal data are included.
- [ ] The single-writer and private self-hosting boundaries remain accurate.

## Compatibility and risk

Describe API or persisted-schema effects, supported Node.js versions, migration needs, security impact, and rollback considerations. Write “None” where a category does not apply.
